title: Broadway Is My Beat
author: Daily Spoken English Tips
description:
The era of radio drama was a time when storytelling was a purely auditory experience, and "Broadway Is My Beat" was a shining example of this art form. Running on CBS from 1949 to 1954, this radio crime drama painted a vivid picture of New York City's underbelly, with Times Square Detective Danny Clover at the center of the action.The show began with Anthony Ross voicing Detective Clover, bringing to life the gritty streets of New York during its first three months. However, it was Larry Thor who would become synonymous with the role for the remainder of the series. The atmospheric music by Robert Stringer and scripts by Peter Lyon set the tone for the dark and moody narratives that unfolded each week.Directed by John Dietz and later produced by Lester Gottlieb, "Broadway Is My Beat" made a significant move from New York to Hollywood. This transition marked a new era for the show, with producer Elliott Lewis at the helm, introducing new scripts by Morton S. Fine and David Friedkin. The iconic opening theme, "I'll Take Manhattan," perfectly encapsulated the essence of Detective Clover's world, from Times Square to Columbus Circle.The show was a collaborative effort, with music by Wilbur Hatch and Alexander Courage complementing the storytelling. The sound effects team, consisting of David Light, Ralph Cummings, and Ross Murray, played a crucial role in recreating the bustling soundscape of Manhattan.The announcers, Bill Anders and Joe Walters, along with a supporting cast featuring Charles Calvert and Jack Kruschen, brought additional depth to the series. Notable guest stars from television, radio, and film graced the episodes, adding star power and variety to the show's roster."Broadway Is My Beat" remains a testament to the golden age of radio drama, showcasing the power of sound to transport listeners to another time and place. It serves as a reminder of the rich history of storytelling before the visual dominance of television and film. title: Baby Moll: The Last Job
author: John Farris
description:
Pete Mallory thought he had left the dangerous world of crime behind, but when Macy Barr, a notorious crime boss, comes calling, he finds himself pulled back in. Once a smart gun for Macy, Pete has been living a quiet life, free from the chaos of organized crime. But when Macy's empire starts to crumble, he needs Pete for one last job, a job that could unlock the secrets of their past and the truth hidden in Macy’s safe. As Pete steps into Macy’s world again, he discovers more than he bargained for: a mysterious woman who ignites a fire within him and a revelation that could change everything.

In "Baby Moll," John Farris crafts a gripping tale filled with tension and unexpected twists. As Pete navigates this treacherous landscape, he must confront his own demons and the choices that led him back to this life. Themes of loyalty, betrayal, and redemption weave through the narrative, making listeners question how far they would go for someone they once trusted. With every turn, the stakes rise, and the past looms larger than life.

Join Pete on this thrilling journey as he races against time, facing enemies old and new, while trying to protect the woman who has captivated his heart. Will he manage to break free from the shadows of his past, or will he be pulled under once again? Tune in to discover the secrets that lie within and experience the heart-pounding suspense of "Baby Moll."

title: The Life Podcast
author: Siddharth Sharma
description: The Life Podcast explores the moments that shape us: career transitions, health, family, leadership, resilience, and personal growth. Hosted by Siddharth Sharma, each episode shares honest conversations and practical insights to help you navigate life's biggest challenges with confidence and purpose.

title: The Last of the Mohicans: Adventures in the Wilderness
author: James Fenimore Cooper
description:
When a British expedition stumbles into the chaos of the French and Indian War, Natty Bumppo, a white frontiersman known as Hawkeye, finds himself in a race against time to rescue two captured sisters from the clutches of danger. Alongside his Mohican allies, Chingachgook and Uncas, Hawkeye navigates treacherous alliances and deadly ambushes, revealing a world torn apart by conflict and loyalty.

As the tension escalates, listeners will dive into themes of survival, cultural clash, and the bonds that form in the face of adversity. The journey unfolds with gripping action, as every choice could mean life or death not just for the sisters but for the very future of the Mohican tribe. What sacrifices will Hawkeye and his companions make to protect their loved ones, and how will their beliefs about honor and bravery be tested?

Set against the backdrop of a pivotal moment in American history, 'The Last of the Mohicans' is not just a tale of war but a profound exploration of identity and resilience. This audiobook invites you into a world of intrigue and heroism, where every character faces their own battle for survival and redemption. Will they emerge victorious, or will the storm of war consume them all? Discover the fate of these unforgettable characters in a story that resonates through the ages.

title: The Weekly Football Face-off

A father‑and‑son football debate show with zero filters and maximum banter.  
Every week we clash over the biggest questions in the game — Premier League hype, underrated players, tactical myths, and the legends we argue about at the dinner table.

title: The Lost Valley and Other Stories: Mysteries of the Beyond
author: Algernon Blackwood
description:
In 'The Lost Valley and Other Stories,' Algernon Blackwood pulls you into the eerie world of supernatural encounters and cryptic folklore. Discover the chilling tale of 'The Wendigo,' where the primal fear of the wilderness takes shape, stalking those who dare to venture too far. In 'The Lost Valley,' a love triangle between twin brothers and a mesmerizing woman unfolds, intertwining their fates with the mysteries of the unknown. Each story invites you to explore the thin veil between reality and the supernatural, where every twist reveals deeper truths about humanity and the cosmos.

Blackwood’s mastery lies in his ability to evoke a sense of wonder and dread simultaneously. In 'Old Clothes,' he challenges the boundaries of life and death, while 'The Price of Wiggins's Orgy' takes a darkly humorous turn, examining the absurdity of desire. 'The Eccentricity of Simon Parnacute' presents an ethereal journey into altruism, leaving listeners pondering the nature of selflessness.

With vivid imagery and rich storytelling, this collection not only delivers spine-tingling horror but also invites reflection on love, sacrifice, and the human experience. As each tale unfolds, you’ll find yourself questioning the line between the ordinary and the extraordinary. Dive into Blackwood’s world, where every story promises a haunting journey that lingers long after the final word.

title: The Menace from Below: Subterranean Secrets
author: Harl Vincent
description:
A subway train vanishes without a trace, leaving a city in panic and a detective desperate for answers. In *The Menace from Below*, Harl Vincent plunges listeners into a gripping mystery that unfolds deep within the labyrinthine tunnels of New York's subway system. What starts as an ordinary day takes a dark turn when a witness sees a murdered man’s body dissolve into the floor, raising chilling questions about the very fabric of reality. Who—or what—are the mysterious subterranean ape men lurking in the shadows?

As the investigation unfolds, each revelation peels back layers of intrigue, exposing the delicate balance between science and the inexplicable. Listeners will find themselves drawn into a world where the impossible becomes possible, and every twist leads to a new revelation. The stakes escalate with each passing moment, challenging our understanding of life, death, and the hidden forces that shape our existence.

Join the journey as our protagonist navigates danger and deception, racing against time to uncover the truth behind these bizarre occurrences. *Menace from Below* is not just a tale of suspense; it’s a thrilling exploration of human resilience in the face of the unknown. Perfect for fans of classic science fiction and mystery, this audiobook promises to keep you on the edge of your seat, eager to uncover what lies beneath the surface.

Is the Governess a reliable narrator, or has her mind begun to unravel under the weight of unseen forces? Prepare for a journey where innocence collides with dread, and nothing is quite as it seems. 'Turn of the Screw' is not just a ghost story; it’s an exploration of fear, perception, and the boundaries of sanity. title: Making Therapy Make Sense
author: Revitalize You
description:
I’m Yvonne Judge, a licensed Independent Marriage and Family Therapist in the state of Ohio. I work with Couples, Individuals and Families on issues ranging from relationship issues to trauma, to personality disorders. I am an EMDR Certified Therapist and an EMDRIA Consultant, specializing in Traditional EMDR, Attachment-Focused EMDR, and EMDR Flash.
Currently, I am a doctoral candidate pursuing my Ph.D. in Marriage and Family Therapy at Northcentral University, where my research and dissertation focus specifically on the intersection of EMDR and relationships.
I am DBT and Personality Disorder Certified, and I serve as an EMDR Consultant, supervisor, and AAMFT Supervisor. To support my clients' diverse needs, I draw from a wide range of clinical models, including DBT, EMDR, Hypnosis, Boundaries work, Structural and Strategic Family Therapy, Gottman Method Couples Counseling, and Emotionally Focused Therapy.
My practice is based in Columbus, Ohio, where I see clients both in person and online across the state. I believe in using what works best for you as an individual, rather than trying to fit you into a box of my making.
My goal with this podcast is to explain various therapy topics, demystify and destigmatize therapy as a whole. And even let you know if it's something you don't need.

description:
Do you love to study God’s Word but get confused because you are searching verse-to-verse for answers? Do you have the confidence to share your faith? Are you craving a community of people like yourself to study and review the Bible with?
I am so glad you are here! This podcast will help you research context, understand the Bible as one story, and learn about creative ways to study to help you feel connected to God’s Word and grow your faith!
Hey, y’all! I’m so glad you are here! I’m Gina, a daughter of the King, mom, GiGi, wife and creative gal who loves to study the Word using all of the creative talent that the Lord gave me. That means I doodle, draw, sketch, and water color in my Bible and I want to teach you how too! We will start in the beginning and read the books of our Bible in chronological order so that our creative minds can draw timelines and do character studies in our own way. 
I used to struggle with what to study. I tried devotionals, but that didn’t give me the type of fulfillment I craved because there was never a story line that I could stay on. So, I started to just open my Bible to find the verse that I thought God had led me to. That worked for me a little bit, but I never knew how to fit it all together into the full story that the Bible has to tell us. 
I have found that my favorite way to study is in the order that the big story happened. I love to dive deep into the characters, the context, the language, the history, and the landscape as if I were there when it happened. I like to “paint” myself in so that I can imagine what it was like while it was happening. 
I created a plan that starts in the beginning and goes in order with a deep dive into context, character studies, word studies, verse mapping, and journaling and I want to share it with you!
So grab your Bible, art supplies, and your morning drink because it is time to dive in!

title: Living from Inside Out
author: Podgo
description: As humans, we are constantly on the lookout for our best selves, evolving, and moving forward to discover our greatest potential. Yet, many of us are still stuck figuring out the first step towards living the life we are truly meant to live. The world can feel chaotic and fast-changing, and it’s easy to get over-stimulated by the pursuit of material success, happiness, and fulfillment. Too often, obtaining these shiny objects never really makes up for the emptiness we feel. Instead of searching for the answers outside, why not take a look at yourself and start connecting with what is inside?  If you are on a personal journey wanting to live a life of greater freedom, happiness, and prosperity, then you are in the right place. Rebecca Victor is calling out heart-centered women, and men, all around the world to start Living from Inside Out.  The founder and CEO of Your Joyful Path, a personal and professional development firm, Rebecca is an experienced coach, speaker, trainer, and content creator dedicated to guiding you on navigating change, turning challenges into opportunities, and prospering through authentic living. Rebecca’s clients focus on  aligning heart, mind and spirit as the key to amplifying successes in all areas of their lives. Rebecca’s clients feel empowered and confident as they live a life of greater freedom, awareness, and confidence.    Referred to as the ‘Queen of Positivity,’ Rebecca is on a mission to engage, uplift, and celebrate women as leaders in business, community, and at home. Her mantra of “Living and Leading from Inside-Out” calls women to take ownership of their personal power to live in integrity and joy with their life’s passion and purpose.  Extending her life-changing wisdom, Rebecca invites you to the Living from Inside-Out podcast where you learn ways to balance your heart, mind, and intuition to live a healthful, happy, and prosperous life.  The life energy we are part of is benevolent. It is for us rather than against us. Through the show, Rebecca reminds us that there is something greater about life, about humanity as a whole, and about who we are that most of us are not consciously aware of or understand. This ‘something more’ rests at our core, and we have the ability to access and experience it with varying degrees of awareness.  With monthly subjects around personal and professional development, this podcast will speak to our journey of Living from Inside-Out—exploring new ideas backed by scientific research, and discoveries, and introducing different practices for personal exploration. And while one person’s journey of inward discovery is unique from the next, there are common experiences generally shared by people. Rebecca invites experts and guests who can provide wisdom and advice that speak to our struggles and help us tap into the wisdom that is already within us and knows the very best for us.  If we expect the world of conditions to be our sole indicator of success, we’re going to find ourselves feeling threatened because we are attempting to stand firmly while our feet are planted on shifting sand. Let’s not allow fear of the unknown to keep us from moving forward on our journeys. Our world is constantly evolving. It cannot be held still. We can either feel victimized by this or develop the skillset to thrive within it.  How do you do this? You can let go of the current constructs that stop you from living your greatest potential. You can turn within to develop the inner wisdom that has always been waiting to burst forth and lead you onward to the next best version of yourself and your life.  Join Rebecca for a fun, light, inspiring, and hopeful podcast that celebrates the magnificence of life. Allow the experience of living from inside-out to help you navigate life’s many changes in a way that is designed to perfectly serve you!

title: The Open Secret Podcast: How People Really Get Into Oxford, Cambridge, and the UK's Top Universities for Postgraduate Study
author: Dr Claire Bergstrom Johnson
description:
Getting into Oxford, Cambridge, and the UK's top universities for postgraduate study can feel like there's a secret code that everyone else was handed and you weren't.


There is. It's just that almost no one says it out loud! The Open Secret is the show that says it out loud.


Hosted by Dr Claire Bergstrom Johnson, a Clarendon Scholar, Oxford DPhil graduate and clinical research fellow, this podcast pulls back the curtain on how people actually win places and full funding at the world's most competitive universities. And Claire knows both sides of it intimately, because before the two fully funded Oxbridge offers, she received 20 graduate rejections in total. When she finally got in, she was the same person with the same grades - just a completely different rebuit approach.


Since then, she's helped thousands of applicants across more than eighty countries, and she's read the real successful postgraduate applications almost no one else gets to see, which means the guidance here isn't guesswork. It's the patterns behind what actually works!


Each episode gives you the honest, insider version of postgraduate admissions: the seven factors that decide how competitive you really are, why fit beats prestige, how funding actually works (and why it's half the battle), what a winning personal statement and reference letter look like, how to approach supervisors, and the mindset shifts that separate the people who get in from the people who talk themselves out of applying.


Whether you're already drafting your application or you're still wondering whether someone like you could ever get in, this is the resource Claire wishes she'd had before her own rejections.


Because the real question isn't whether it's possible. It's *why not you?*


New episodes weekly. For the full self-assessment and the resources mentioned in the show, head to oxbridgeadmissionsclub.com.

title: Teachers Underground
author: Doug VomSteeg
description:
So here's what I'm curious about - when did public education become such a punchline that we can't even talk about the real stories happening in our classrooms?


Here's the thing that doesn't make sense to me: we've got incredible teachers doing amazing work every single day, but instead of hearing their voices, we get endless bureaucratic theater and consultant-speak from people who haven't stepped foot in a classroom since the Bush administration. 


Welcome to Teachers Underground - where we collect the "Wait, what?" moments that make you question everything you thought you knew about American education. We're not here to trash teaching; we're here to save it by telling the truth.


The best insights about education aren't coming from textbooks or think tanks - they're coming from the trenches. From teachers who've figured out how to make magic happen despite systems designed to prevent it. From educators who've learned to navigate absurdity with humor, heart, and a healthy dose of snark.

So here's our mission: expose the bureaucratic nonsense, celebrate the unsung heroes, and create a space where the spirit of teaching gets lifted up instead of beaten down. Because honestly? Public education is already a punchline - we're just here to write better material.


Join us every other week as we explore the underbelly of American campuses with five veteran educators who've seen it all and lived to laugh about it.


Because sometimes the best way to fix something broken is to first admit how wonderfully, hilariously, frustratingly broken it really is.

author: Destiny
description: Raw conversations about motherhood, healing, spirituality, money, growth, and figuring it out one day at a time.

title: Endo Out Loud Podcast
author: Emily Timberlake, Sage Griffith
description: We are a show meant to bring awareness to endometriosis. We will discuss accurate information about endometriosis and it's symptoms, speak to experts, and talk to women living with endometriosis, giving them a safe space to share their stories.

title: Business and Tribal Law Environments
author: Sitting Bull College
description: Lectures, case studies, and analyses on business development, sovereignty, and Tribal law at Sitting Bull College, hosted by Instructor Cara DiMare.

title: Faculty in Fifteen
author: The University of Guelph
description:
Faculty in Fifteen is the latest podcast from the University of Guelph featuring one-on-one interviews with our incredible faculty.
Through fifteen questions, and over fifteen minutes (roughly), you’ll get the chance to learn all about their work, expertise and a little about themselves.
From groundbreaking research to personal stories and insights, Faculty in Fifteen offers an engaging look at the faculty whose curiosity, creativity, and passion are united by a shared commitment to Improve Life.

title: Kingdom Wild
author: The Wild Ones
description: A group of young adults burning for the things of God.

title: On the Menu
author: Lake & Sumter Style Magazine
description: Join host Gina Horan, food and lifestyle editor at Style Magazine, as she explores the people, flavors and stories shaping the local food scene.

title: AdTech Women Power by Blasto
author: Polina Smoliar, CMO at Blasto
description:
AdTech Women Power by Blasto is a podcast and interview series dedicated to the voices, ideas, and leadership of women shaping the future of advertising technology.
Programmatic advertising, data infrastructure, AI-powered media buying, connected TV, retail media, and privacy-first advertising are transforming the global marketing ecosystem. Hosted by the team at Blasto, a global programmatic advertising ecosystem, the podcast goes beyond surface-level discussions and focuses on the real mechanics of the industry: how companies grow, how technology evolves, how leadership decisions made.

title: Soul Hugs Podcast
author: Alisha
description: Soul Hugs Podcast is a space where healing, honest conversations, and gentle encouragement come together. Whether you are navigating heartbreak, friendships, personal growth, or life's transitions, there is always a seat for you. Think of this as a warm hug for your soul.

title: Fantasy Football with Ian Hartitz
author: RotoWire
description:
Welcome to Fantasy Football with Ian Hartitz — your home for winning fantasy football advice, powered by RotoWire.
Ian breaks down everything you need to dominate your leagues: draft rankings and tiers, sleepers and breakouts, busts to avoid, waiver-wire pickups, start/sit calls, and the stats that actually matter — all season long, from training camp through your championship week. No fluff, no hedging. Just sharp, research-driven fantasy football analysis with the occasional hot take that ages beautifully (or doesn't — we keep the receipts).
🏈 New shows multiple times a week, all season long
📊 Rankings, tiers, sleepers, waiver wire, start/sit, DFS and betting angles

Subscribe and let's win your league.

title: Real Bay Area Memes Podcast
author: Abraham Woodliff
description: Real Bay Area Memes Podcast is a satirical look at the world's most expensive reality show: the San Francisco Bay Area. Hosted by Abraham Woodliff, combining comedy, local journalism, interviews, and internet brain rot , Explore the people, politics, tech billionaires, the housing disasters, & other cultural oddities that make the Bay Area the greatest and most ridiculous place in America. Part news, part comedy, & part public therapy session.

title: Sacred Sitdowns
author: Kyle
description: Sharing one’s personal story is sometimes hard, but it is holy. Sacred Sitdowns seeks to allow a safe space for faith-filled conversations with members and friends of Geist Christian Church. Hosts Kyle Brown and Danny Gulden hope that all those who hear will be enlightened and inspired. Listen with us. You’ll be glad you did.

title: Late Night / Unfiltered Vibe
author: Daman
description:
Welcome to The Late Night / Unfiltered Vibe.
You know that shift when the sun goes down, the daytime filters come off, and you finally say what you’re actually thinking? This is that space. We’re stripping away the polite talk to unpack the real stuff: raw mental health, modern relationship dynamics, and the psychology behind the week's wildest headlines.
Grab a drink, turn down the lights, and settle in. It’s late, we’re unfiltered, and we’re talking about what keeps us up at night. New episodes weekly.

title: My beautiful bipolar life
author: Kelly Bauer
description: What started as a cross country bucket list journey with my terminally ill and estranged father, evolved into a search and rescue effort. To find the little girl who got lost amongst generational trauma, domestic violence and societal expectations. I found the fearless wildflower who loved herself and was ready to change the world. In my father’s death, I discovered the life I was supposed to live, while evolving into the woman I am today.  I hope this podcast is a safe place to land for those wanting to heal, grow and live an authentic life rooted in gratitude, kindness, limited f***s and yummy snacks.

title: Enrich+Elevate
author: Future Focused Academy
description: Enrich+Elevate amplifies the voices of Erie’s young adults as they explore real‑world topics, interview local leaders, and share the stories shaping their futures.

title: Death & Dying: a never-ending story
author: Peter Darby-Knight
description:
A podcast where everyday people share a fictional story of their choice that connects them to death and dying. We then explore what these stories have taught them about death.
This podcast has arisen from my work as a drama psychotherapist when supporting people who are facing death and dying. People who have made use of story to connect with their emotions when facing some of the most challenging times of their lives.
Find out more about me: www.peterdarbyknight.co.uk 
Music and lyrics by Tom Veck: www.mindfulness-now.com/what-the-veck

title: Cultura & Flow
author: Jeezus
description:
Welcome! Bienvenidos a Cultura & Flow, a show dedicated to mixing my own personal roots and cultures and showcasing some of my favorite songs as well. Other shows soon to come featuring very different genres from Reggaeton to Hip Hop EDM and in between. Desde mis raizes en Mexico to North Texas (DFW) para el mundo. I Hope you enjoy as much as I do! Hasta la proxima, mis ñeros!


Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Where Growth Matters
author: ConnectedLife Church
description: Discussions around personal transformation, being fruitful and how to multiply what really matters.

title: Libraries Change Lives
author: Public Libraries Victoria
description:
What happens behind the scenes of the projects, partnerships and ideas shaping Victoria's public libraries?
Join Christine Peters and Michelle McLean from Public Libraries Victoria as they chat with library staff, sector leaders and partners about the work happening across our libraries.
From early years literacy and community wellbeing to innovation, advocacy and professional practice, each episode explores the challenges, successes and stories behind the projects helping libraries and communities thrive.
